title: The Best Apple Black Friday Deals, All in One Place
gist: Promotional roundup of Apple Black Friday discounts. Main signals: AirPods Pro 3 hit an all-time low of $149 (40% off), the MacBook Air M5 drops to $999, while the low-cost MacBook Neo ($699) gets only a $50 cut and is criticized for limited RAM.

insights.claim: Apple AirPods Pro 3 are discounted 40% to $149 at Amazon and Walmart for Black Friday, the lowest price they have ever been.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Unusually deep retailer discounting on Apple's flagship earbuds may signal channel inventory or aggressive holiday promotion in wearables.
insights.locator: AirPods Pro 3 are finally, actually on sale.

insights.claim: Apple's inexpensive MacBook Neo, priced around $699, rarely drops in price and is only $50 off for Black Friday; WIRED says it is adequate for basic use but wishes it had more RAM.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Apple holds pricing discipline on its new entry-level Mac, with RAM as the noted weak point.
insights.locator: The inexpensive MacBook Neo doesn't drop in price very often

insights.claim: WIRED calls the MacBook Air (M5, 2026) the best laptop for most people of any kind, with its price the main drawback, now discounted to $999 for the 13-inch model.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Strong reviewer endorsement supports MacBook Air holiday demand.
insights.locator: We love this MacBook and think it's the best option

insights.claim: AirPods Max 2 are discounted to $419 from $549; WIRED notes they basically never drop very far in price.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Rare discount on a premium Apple product is consistent with broad holiday promotional intensity.
insights.locator: For over-ear headphone enthusiasts looking to keep thing Apple
